query:
SELECT s.state_name, s.district, s.candidate1, s.candidate2, s.status, s.rating, s.primary_date, s.general_date 
FROM senate_races s
WHERE s.state_name IN ('West Virginia', 'Nebraska')
UNION ALL
SELECT h.state_name, h.district, h.candidate1, h.candidate2, h.status, h.rating, h.primary_date, h.general_date 
FROM house_races h
WHERE h.state_name IN ('West Virginia', 'Nebraska')
ORDER BY state_name, district;
